title: What does Aman Kaushik do?
content: Aman Kaushik is an AI/ML and full-stack engineer with Android engineering experience. His work focuses on practical applications involving Python, Generative AI, RAG, LLMs, and modern user interfaces.

title: What is Aman's current role?
content: Aman is currently a Trainee Software Engineer at GlobalLogic India Private Limited in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The role began in January 2026 and focuses on AI/ML-oriented software engineering.

title: Is Aman available for opportunities?
content: Yes. Aman is available for AI/ML, Python, and full-stack opportunities and is open to relevant engineering opportunities.

title: Where is Aman based?
content: Aman is based in Bangalore, India, and is from Muzaffarpur, Bihar.

title: What is Aman's education background?
content: Aman earned a B.Tech in Information Technology from Lovely Professional University in Jalandhar, Punjab, completing it in September 2025. He also completed Intermediate education with PCM and Matriculation under the CBSE board.

title: Does Aman work with RAG and LLMs?
content: Yes. RAG and LLMs are included in Aman's applied AI skills, and his current role includes Generative AI and LLM workflows involving prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and RAG.

title: What projects has Aman built?
content: The portfolio presents four projects: Poetic Pebbles, a published Android poetry-sharing application; HireSense AI, an AI recruitment analysis tool; Kaushik Footprints, a full-stack e-commerce application; and a Land Bidding Platform, a full-stack MERN property marketplace.

content: You can contact Aman by email at amankaushik2810@gmail.com, connect through LinkedIn, or explore his work on GitHub.
